issues.description: The proposal presents an incremental lightweight integration layer as a settled fact in the core technical approach, despite CTO Marcus Patel strongly favoring a complete rebuild (which is flagged as a contradicted item in the Client Matrix). Stating this as a settled strategy in the main body creates a contradiction with Open Question #1 and risks alienating key technical leadership.
issues.suggested_fix: Reframe Section 4 of the Approach to state that an incremental service layer is the recommended Phase 1 pattern to meet the Q3 deadline, while explicitly noting that architectural alignment with CTO Marcus Patel on the long-term rebuild strategy will be finalized during the Week 2 Discovery workshop.

issues.description: While the proposal addresses CFO Rita Donovan's budget and Q3 timeline constraints, it misses an opportunity to explicitly address her skepticism arising from the 2023 vendor failure.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a dedicated sentence in the Executive Summary or Pricing section explicitly highlighting how the fixed-fee milestone gate structure directly mitigates vendor performance risk and guarantees financial protection.

risks: CTO Marcus Patel may reject the proposal during evaluation if he feels the technical strategy prematurely dismisses his vision for a full application rebuild.
Tight alignment is required to ensure the Phase 3 production pilot hits the September 30 deadline, as missing this date risks reallocation of project funding by the CFO.
